data.name: CollectionsBridge_Desc_Key
data.value: Shares the customer and view with Microsoft 365 Copilot and handles the Collections agent's actions.

data.name: customerNumber_Desc_Key
data.value: Bind to the BC customer number column.

data.name: autoOpenPanel_Desc_Key
data.value: Open the Microsoft 365 Copilot panel once context is published.

data.name: viewName_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the view reported to Copilot (default: Overdue invoices).

data.name: analyzePrompt_Desc_Key
data.value: Prompt sent by the Analyze payment behavior button.

data.name: asOfDate_Desc_Key
data.value: Optional YYYY-MM-DD used as today for ageing (rehearsals). Empty = the real date.

data.name: creditLimit_Desc_Key
data.value: Optional. The credit limit column; Copilot can propose a new value, which the control fills in without saving.

data.name: blocked_Desc_Key
data.value: Optional. The Blocked column; Copilot can propose a new status, which the control fills in without saving.

data.name: showContextSwitch_Desc_Key
data.value: Demo only: shows a "Share context with Copilot" switch, to compare the agent with and without the record's context.

data.name: customerNumberPrefix_Desc_Key
data.value: Optional. Limits all-customer views (dashboard) to customer numbers starting with this, e.g. DEMO-C-. Same as the MCP server's CUSTOMER_NUMBER_PREFIX.

data.name: worklistViewId_Desc_Key
data.value: Optional saved view (GUID) to switch to when the agent shows the worklist.
